text_block_list.text:
The injury Эйр Грув sustained during
training is
hurting, so I take her to the
infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Tch... How foolish of me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I should have been more observant. This
is
completely my fault.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I need to do whatever I can to make up
for this
silly loss of time!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Take it easy until you're all better.

We can think about a new training regimen
together.

text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to waste time over
something like
this!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I am extremely calm! That's why I—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ngh...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: You shouldn't move around too much.

text_block_list.text:
What world are you living in?! I don't
have the
time to think about my
regimen!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I need to be out there making up for this
lost time
as soon as physically possible!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
We can train in a way that won't
aggravate the
injury. I won't let some
silly wound get in my way.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Patience is beside the—urgh!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув tries to move, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gasp, gasp... Even simple stretches are... tiring.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: My regimen, huh?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's the best I can do for
now. Even if
I'm not able to move as I
wish, I can still use my
mind.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Very well. I'll bite.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
This recent incident has revealed to us
what level
of training will harm me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this injury is a blessing in
disguise.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Now we can devise training regimens
that won't
push me too far beyond what
I'm capable of.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's injury is more serious than
she
realized.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After that, we discuss a training regimen
that
would be effective and tough, while
remaining
manageable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Fine... I'll focus on getting better first.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
